[[File:Imcando hammer (off-hand) detail.png|left|100px]]
'''Imcando hammer (off-hand)''' is a variant of the [[Imcando hammer]] that can be equipped in the [[shield slot]]. A broken Imcando hammer is obtained through smashing [[barronite deposit]]s on the [[Barronite Crusher|barronite crusher]] in the [[Ruins of Camdozaal]] after completing the [[Below Ice Mountain]] [[quest]]. Once repaired by [[Ramarno]], the hammer can be swapped between its normal and off-hand variants by using the "Swap" option.

The hammer functions identically to the normal variant. The off-hand variant is particularly useful at [[Motherlode Mine]] as it allows the player to repair [[Strut|broken struts]] while still having a [[pickaxe]] equipped, and without taking up any inventory space.

Although the main hand variant can be handed back to [[Ramarno]] for [[Barronite shards]], attempting to return the off-hand hammer will not work.
{{Costume storage|magic wardrobe}}

It can also be used in a [[free-to-play]] [[Server|world]], despite being a [[members object]]. Though it can only be equipped in a [[members]]' world, if it is already equipped or in the player's inventory upon logging into a free-to-play world, the hammer retains its usual functionality, regardless of the player's membership status.
